# Test fixtures

## astronaut.jpg

- Source: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/v0.25.2/skimage/data/astronaut.png`
- Subject: Eileen Collins, NASA astronaut. Photograph by NASA.
- License: public domain, as stated in scikit-image's data documentation (`skimage.data.astronaut`).
- Changes: downscaled from 512 x 512 to 256 x 256 pixels with OpenCV (area interpolation) and saved as JPEG at quality 90 (22,877 bytes).
